Agent Name: InformationExtraction_Expert
Step Number: 2
Reason for Mistake: The InformationExtraction_Expert made a logical error in Step 2 when attempting to link the city of Duluth (identified in Step 1) to a landmark building in Chicago. The expert incorrectly assumed that because Duluth is named after an explorer, there must be a building in Chicago named after him or a related figure (confusing the etymology of Duluth with the name of the John Hancock Center). The expert failed to verify if the namesake of Duluth had a landmark building in Chicago named after him, instead arbitrarily selecting the John Hancock Center based on a flawed association with Hancock, Michigan. This led to the incorrect identification of the building and the subsequent wrong answer regarding the architectural firm.
